doc.name: Pinmade: local makers
doc.instructions: Pinmade is a worldwide, hand-checked map of local makers (shops that make their own things, with a place you can walk into). Use search_shops to find them by words, category, place or distance; link people to each shop's Pinmade page, which has directions and up-to-date hours.

tools.name: search_shops
tools.title: Search local makers
tools.description: Find hand-checked local makers on Pinmade: shops that design and make their own things (clothing, leather, ceramics, crafts…) with a place you can walk into. Filter by words, category, place, distance and open now. Returns each shop's page link, address, opening hours and what they make.

radius_km.description: Distance from lat/lng in km (default 5, max 50)

open_now.description: Only shops open right now (their local time)

tools.name: get_shop
tools.title: Get one shop
tools.description: Full details of one Pinmade shop by its slug (the last part of its page address).

tools.name: list_places
tools.title: List places with shops
tools.description: Countries, regions, cities and neighbourhoods that have shops on Pinmade, with how many.
